newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 14-THURSDAY, JANUARY 23.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 14-THURSDAY, JANUARY 23.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JANUARY 14

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-124/95 Centro-Com: commercial policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 113 and of Council regulation 1432/92 of June 1, 1992, banning trade between the EU and the republics of Serbia and Montenegro. National regulation banning the liberation of funds belonging to a person established in Serbia or Montenegro to pay the citizen of another member state for products exported from this state towards Serbia or Montenegro. Products approved as being for medical purposes in accordance with a United Nations resolution. - Judgment C-169/95 Spain v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of March 14, 1995, on aid to investment granted by the Spanish government to Piezas y Rodajes SA. Aid meeting the conditions for regional aid previously approved by the Commission. - Judgment joined cases C-192/95, C-193/95, C-194/95, C-195/95, C-196/95, C-197/95, C-198/95, C-199/95, C-200/95, C-201/95, C-202/95, C-203/95, C-204/95, C-205/95, C-206/95, C-207/95, C-208/95, C-209/95, C-210/95, C-211/95, C-212/95, C-213/95, C-214/95, C-215/95, C-216/95, C-217/95, C-218/95, Comateb: principles of Community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Community law on repetition of the undue. Conditions of repayment of sea grants in the French overseas departments. National law subjecting refund rights to the non-incorporation of taxes unduly collected in the sale price and obliging the taxable party to incorporate the litigious tax in the cost price. - Opinion C-180/95 Draehmpaehl: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2, paragraph 1 and 3, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. National law setting out conditions on the right to compensation for damages in cases of discrimination. Employer at fault. Damages limited to a sum corresponding to three months' salary and six months' salary to be distributed among several workers. - Opinion C-310/95 Road Air: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 132, paragraph 1, 133, paragraph 1 and 134. Validity of Council decision 86/283 of June 30, 1986, on the association of overseas countries and territories to the EU as well as of Council decision 91/110 of February 27, 1991. Nature of relations between the EU and the PTOMs - free trade zone or Customs Union. Import of goods freely traded in the Dutch Antilles but originating in a third country. Exemption from customs duties. Applicability. - Oral procedure C-408/95 Eurotunnel: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of transitional duty-free shops arrangements resulting from article 28, paragraph 12 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment, as amended by article 1, point 22 of Council directive 91/680/EEC of December 16, 1991, completing the common VAT system and amending, with a view to abolishing fiscal borders, Council directive 77/188/EEC. Validity of article 28 of Council directive 92/12/EEC of February 25, 1992, on general arrangements for products subject to excise duty and on the holding, movement and monitoring of such products. In case of annulment, possibility of basing exemptions on Council directive 94/4/EEC of February 14, 1994, amending directive 69/169/EEC and 77/388/EEC and increasing the level of exemption for travellers from a third country and tax-free purchase limits during intra-Community trips. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 173 and 177. Failure to introduce an action for annulment against directives on the basis of EC treaty article 173.

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-128/95 Fontaine: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission regulation 123/85 of December 12, 1984, on the application of EC treaty article 85, paragraph 3 on distribution, sales service and after-sales service agreements on automotive vehicles. Notion of new and used vehicles. Parallel importer able to operate as both an official dealer and a reseller of imported vehicles.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 15

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-158/96 Kohll: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 59 and 60. National social security arrangements subjecting the repayment of services furnished in a member state other than the insured party's member state of residence to approval from a social security body. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-212/96 Chevassus-Marche: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity and interpretation of Council decision 89/688 of December 22, 1989, on dock dues in the French overseas departments. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12, 13 and 92, paragraph 2. Regulation permitting an exemption in favour of local businesses in said departments on condition that these businesses contribute to the development or maintenance of a local economic activity.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-81/95 Interhotel v/ Commission: social policy. Annulment of Commission decision of December 28, 1994, reducing the initial financial contribution of the European Social Fund in training initiatives following the Court annulment (May 7, 1991 judgment) of a first decision to reduce the Fund's financial contributions.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-77/95 SFEI v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 30, 1992, rejecting the complaint against the French post office and the French state, lodged by the claimant on the basis of EC treaty articles 86 and 90 and concerning the international express courier market.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 16

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-57/95 France v/ Commission: company law. Annulment of Commission communication 94/C 360/08 on the internal market for pension funds. Freedom to manage and invest funds collected by pension institutions.

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-114/94 IDE v/ Commission: company law. Action based on arbitration clause. Contract for the development of a computer programme. "Disnet" project. Payment of balance.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-273/95 Buratti: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 10 to 12 of Commission regulation 3478/92 of December 1, 1992, laying down detailed rules for the application of the premium system for raw tobacco. Granting of premiums for leaf tobacco. Date of delivery. Producers or processors co-operative.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-164/95 Fabrica de Queijo Eru Portuguesa: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission regulation 316/91 of February 7, 1991, on the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature. Positions NC 0406 2090 (all types of grated and powdered cheeses) and NC 0406 9011 (cheeses other than fresh, grated, powdered, fondue, or parsleyed paste, intended for processing). Grated cheese, pressed and packaged, with oxygen substitution by nitrogen injection, compact and pasty in appearance, that breaks into irregular granules after unwrapping and exposure to normal conditions.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-94/95, C-95/95 Bonifaci: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation and validity of article 4, paragraph 2 of Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the harmonisation of member states legislation on the protection of salaried workers in cases of employer insolvency. Underwriters' obligation to pay. Faculty for member states to establish limits. Breach by a member state of the obligation to transpose a directive. Damages to individuals. Modes and conditions. - Opinion C-258/95 Julius Fillibeck Soehne: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 2, point 1 and 6, paragraph 2 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Performance of services for profit. Use of a company asset. Service performed by the taxable party for the private needs of his staff. Worker transport between their place of residence and the work place offered free of charge by the employer in accordance with a collective convention. - Opinion C-260/95 DFDS: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 26 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Special arrangements for travel agencies. Agency headquartered in member state A furnishing package tours to travellers through the intermediary of a company based in member state B. Circumstances in which these services are subject to VAT in member state B. Notion of a member state in which the travel agency has set up the headquarters of its economic activity and of a stable base from which services have been provided. - Opinion C-261/95 Palmisani: principles of Community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 5. National law regulating deadlines for the introduction of actions for damages resulting from rights granted to individuals in cases of the delayed transposition of a directive. Deadline less favourable than those applying to analogue actions under internal law. - Opinion C-373/95 Maso: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the protection of salaried workers in cases of employer insolvency. Compensation for damages caused to individuals resulting from the non-transposition of a directive. System fixing a ceiling for the amount of compensation. - Opinion C-197/96 Commission v/ France: social policy. Non-respect. Article 5, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Ban on night work by women in industry in the absence of a similar ban for men. - Oral procedure joined cases C-248/95, C-249/95 SAM Schiffahrt: transport. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 1101/89 of April 27, 1989, on structural improvements in internal navigation, of Commission regulation 1102/89 of April 27, 1989, laying down detailed rules for the application of Commission regulations 1101/89 and 3685/89 of December 8, 1989, amending regulation 1102/89. Arrangements for demolition premium. Appreciation of the usefulness of dispositions based on EC treaty article 75, paragraph 1(c). - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure joined cases C-370/95, C-371/95, C-372/95 Careda: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National tax on exploitation of gaming machines calculated on the amount at stake and where the repercussion on the consumer by the taxable party is not specifically provided for.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-134/95 USSL no 47 di Biella: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 48, 49, 54 and 90. National legislation reserving worker placement activities to a public monopoly. Co-operative company acting as manual worker intermediary. Ban. - Opinion C-147/95 Evrenopoulos: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 119, of protocol 2 in annex to the Maastricht treaty and of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Insurance arrangements concerning the staff of a public electricity company. Survivors' pensions. Conditions for granting to surviving male partners. Court action. - Opinion C-351/95 Kadiman: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 7 of Council decision 1/80 of the EEC/Turkey association. Family member of a Turkish worker regularly employed in a member state. Conditions for obtaining the prolongation of a residence permit. Determination of the period of stay in cases where there are interruptions. - Opinion C-23/96 Commission v/ France: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/507/EEC of July 19, 1991, amending the annex of Council directive 75/318/EEC of May 20, 1975, on the harmonisation of member states legislation on toxico-pharmacological norms and analytical protocols on trials for pharmaceutical specialities. - Opinion C-135/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/659/EEC of December 3, 1991, adapting to technical innovation annex I of Council directive 76/769/EEC on the coordination of member states' laws, regulations and administrative provisions on limits on the marketing and use of certain dangerous substances and preparations (asbestos). - Oral procedure C-400/95 Dansk Handel and Service: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Dismissal by reason of absences due to illnesses attributable to pregnancy or childbearing. - (1015/0915 GMT) Oral procedure C-165/95 Lay: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 2055/93 of July 19, 1993, attributing a specific benchmark lot size to certain milk producers or milk products. Partial cessation of an operation. Determination of the specific benchmark lot size between the assignor and the partial transferee on the basis of pasture acreage. Notion of "pasture in acreage". - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-114/96 Kieffer: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 3330/91 of November 7, 1991, on trade statistics between member states. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Interpretation of article 3B, 3 line of EC treaty as encompassed by article G, point 5, of the Maastricht treaty. Principle of proportionality regarding a national law punishing a refusal to furnish information required in application of the INTRASTAT data gathering system.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, JANUARY 21-23
TUESDAY, JANUARY 21

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-334/95 Krueger: agriculture. (1100/1000 GMT) - Oral procedure C-353/95-P Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission: state aid. - Oral procedure joined cases C-359/95-P, C379/95-P Commission v/ Ladbroke Racing: competition.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 22

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-322/95 Iuriaro: free movement of persons. - (1030/0930 GMT) oral procedure C-45/96 Bayerische Hypotheken-und Wechselbank: environment and consumers. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-63/96 Skripalle: taxation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-269/95 Benincasa: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-354/95 Farmer's Union: agriculture. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-398/98 Syndesmos ton en Elladi Touristikon: free movement of persons. - (1630/1530 GMT) Oral procedure C-154/96 Wolfs: social policy.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-115/94 Opel Austria v/ Council: external relations.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 23
COURT OF JUSTICE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-246/95 Coen: company law.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-153/95 ANDRE: agriculture.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-300/95 Commission v/ United Kingdom: environment and consumers. - Opinion C-347/95 UCAL: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-28/96 Fricarnes: free movement of goods. opinion C-153/96-P de Rijk v/ Commission: Statute of officials. - Oral procedure C-329/95 VAG Sverige: free movement of goods. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-389/95 Klattner: taxation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-463/93 St. Martinus Elten: agriculture. - Judgment C-29/95 Pastoors: principles of Community law. - Judgment C-171/95 Tetik: external relations. - Judgment C-181/95 Biogen: approximation of legislation. - Judgment C-314/95 Commission v/ Italy: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-266/95 Merino Garcia: free movement of persons. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-285/95 Kol: external relations.
